name: Baasha
title: The Evil King of Israel
summary: Baasha was the third king of the northern kingdom of Israel. He seized power by killing King Nadab, son of Jeroboam, and wiped out the entire house of Jeroboam. He reigned for 24 years from Tirzah, but continued in the sins of Jeroboam by leading Israel into idolatry, which brought God's judgment upon his own dynasty.

keyEvents.title: Conspiracy Against Nadab
keyEvents.description: Baasha conspired against King Nadab, son of Jeroboam, and killed him at Gibbethon while Israel was besieging a Philistine city. He then seized the throne over Israel.

keyEvents.title: Destruction of Jeroboam's House
keyEvents.description: After seizing power, Baasha wiped out the entire family of Jeroboam, fulfilling the prophecy of the prophet Ahijah concerning judgment on the house of Jeroboam.

keyEvents.title: Reigned for 24 years from Tirzah
keyEvents.description: Baasha reigned over Israel for 24 years with Tirzah as the capital, but he did what was evil in the Lord's sight and walked in the way of Jeroboam.

keyEvents.title: The prophet Jehu's judgment against Baasha
keyEvents.description: The Lord sent the prophet Jehu son of Hanani with a message of judgment against Baasha because he followed the sins of Jeroboam and provoked God to anger. God prophesied that Baasha's house would become like Jeroboam's house.

keyEvents.title: War against Judah and fortification of Ramah
keyEvents.description: Baasha marched up against Judah and fortified Ramah to prevent people from traveling to or from King Asa in Judah. This led Asa to seek help from the Arameans in Damascus.

keyEvents.title: The death of Baasha and Elah's succession
keyEvents.description: Baasha died and was buried in Tirzah. His son Elah succeeded him as king over Israel, but his dynasty was soon wiped out through Zimri's conspiracy.
